name: Attacking the Middle
summary: Sharpen your crossover, score off the snake dribble and finish middle drives, then finish with a conditioning test.

drills.name: Wide-to-Tight Crossovers
drills.summary: Warm up your hands by working the crossover from wide to quick and tight.
steps: Get in a low stance with feet wider than your shoulders.
Cross the ball wide, from outside your left foot to outside your right foot, for 30 seconds.
Bring it in to a tight crossover between your knees, as fast as you can, for 30 seconds.
Switch every 30 seconds between wide and tight.
Finish the last minute walking forward, using wide and tight crossovers.

drills.name: Snake Dribble Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Come off an imaginary ball screen, snake back to the middle and rise up.
steps: Put a cone at the top of the key as the screener.
Start on the wing and dribble tight off the cone with your right hand.
Cross back left in front of the cone to snake into the lane.
Pick it up on two feet at the elbow and shoot.
Get your own rebound and go again from the other wing.
Take 5 shots each side, then repeat.

drills.name: Middle Drive Counter Finishes
drills.summary: Drive middle, read the help and counter with a pivot finish.
steps: Start on the right wing in triple threat.
Drive middle with your left hand and jump stop just inside the lane line.
Show the ball up like you're shooting the short jumper.
Reverse pivot toward the baseline and finish with your right hand off the glass.
Do 6 reps, then switch to the left wing and finish with your left hand.

drills.name: Sprint-Back Box-Outs
drills.summary: Sprint back on defense, box out and chase the rebound when your legs are tired.
steps: Start on the baseline holding the ball.
Sprint to half court and touch the line.
Backpedal to the free throw line and get into stance.
Toss the ball off the backboard, turn and hold a box-out for one second.
Go get the ball at its highest point and land on two feet.
Rest 15 seconds, then repeat until time is up.
